C8 has cited Pollack’s standard harmonic analysis, which reduces the opening of “Norwegian Wood” to an immediate **E → Bm** movement—E as I, Bm as v—i.e., precisely the clue’s language of “tonic to the minor fifth chord.” C14 found a chord/trivia reference using essentially the same description.
